When you are starting out people will say stuff like a good suspension, maneuverability, torque, RPMs, start small, don't get a 600cc...

Truth is, when I got my '07 ex250 I understood what people where saying, but I could not feel it for myself.

Truth is, when I bought my little ninja I bought it for cheap, I wanted something to learn on, and to drop without feeling too guilty.

Now most people will tell you that you'll soon outgrow a 125 or a 250, get an SV650 they rule, and I'm sure they do, other people will say they learned on a Hayabusa with a 40" extended swingarm.

But in the end you are your own person. I'm still happy with my ex250 although I had to replace the engine recently, I've changed the shock for one from a GSXR, and I can do 90mph all day long which is more than I personally need (I'm 6'4" 270lbs).

I want many bikes, I want a klr650 (2007 or older), I want a v-strom 650, I want a KTM 690 Supemoto, I want a naked sv650...

Maybe I'll get an SV650 next and completely feel like is the best bike I could ever buy. Maybe I'll keep riding the ex250. Maybe I'll be able to afford the KTM and get an extra set of enduro wheels... And I may get everything I want from riding from that, then again I may not.

Listen to everyone's advice, but be certain that whatever you choose, you'll be definitely making your own path, and if you make mistakes along the way, that will also be experience, and you'll hopefully end up more knowledgeable and better know what works for you.
